assessments.reasoning: The three verified publisher ranges perform distinct roles. Section 1.5 defines status, section 10.4 imposes the conditional distribution duty, and Exhibit B identifies the notice to attach. The normative inference rests on these provisions.

limitations: Application requires evidence of the distribution choice and of actual attachment by the initial Contributor or qualifying prior licensing. Exhibit B identifies the required notice but does not establish those facts.
reasoning: Section 10.4 requires attachment of the Exhibit B notice when the distributor chooses to distribute incompatible Source Code Form under MPL 2.0. Section 1.5 supplies two independently sufficient grounds for that status.
